description_en: Retrieves a list of service configurations
kebab_example: aliyun searchplat list-function-instances --workspace-name default --function-name deployment --model-type ai_search --function-type PAAS --source user --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-output simple --api-version 2024-04-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFunctionInstances

parameters.help_en:
The instance source. Valid values:
- builtin: system instance
- user: user instance (default)
- all: all instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例来源
- builtin 系统实例
- user 用户实例 （默认）

parameters.help_en:
The level of detail in the response. Valid values:
- simple: displays only basic information
- normal: displays information such as createParameters and cron (default)
- detail: returns training task information
